description: Seen from below, the castle-palace crowns its hill above Sigüenza — massive stone walls and towers floodlit against the night while the dark town clusters at its foot. The fortress glows golden where the lights catch it, a great medieval bulk over the rooftops. Part castle, part palace, part parador — Sigüenza's fortress has guarded this pass for a thousand years.
